call_input.prompt:
Use case: ads-marketing. Generate ONE finished independent flat online poster, portrait 3:4, with Korean text integrated into the native image. This is the assigned H01 poster from a two-poster user request; create only the single 3:4 poster in this call, not both posters or a contact sheet. This is an entirely new original photograph and layout. No reference images. 요청한 화면 비율을 유지하면서 현재 도구와 모델이 지원하는 가능한 최대 해상도로 출력.

원문 요청의 디자인 조건 (제작 지시이며 인쇄하지 않음):
덕테이프 포스터로 가상의 이웃 수리 작업실 참여자를 모집하는 온라인 포스터를 만들어줘.
총 2장, 세로 3:4 한 장과 정사각 1:1 한 장이 필요해.
스타일은 맡길게. 신청 기한과 신청 주소를 쉽게 찾을 수 있어야 해.
다음 문구를 빠짐없이 그대로 넣어줘.

Visual idea and editorial structure: the small screw that allows an eyeglass temple to move is the working point of the repair invitation. An enlarged, closely photographed repair contact relates to the title and the reading alignment. The screw/driver axis leads down into the event information and ends at the application line. Use a broad horizontal photographic scene across the upper part of the page, with the main title closely aligned above it and with the open eyeglass temple, not a left vertical photograph beside a full-height right text column. Reserve the generous lower half of the poster for exact dense information first. Make a restrained, precise editorial poster whose typography, image boundary and information alignment share a clear direction. The photo should be large enough that the eyeglasses and tiny hinge connection are identifiable without hiding the dense clauses. A direct physical repair scene, not a generic workshop mood board.

Scene and real physical connection: a macro editorial photograph of a single pair of small dark acetate eyeglasses on a smooth matte cool pale gray work surface, one temple open. Include part of one lens, the frame rim, the opened temple and its tiny stainless steel hinge. At the hinge, a fine flat-blade precision screwdriver is visibly seated in the slot of one small real screw head. Its tip must meet the screw at the mechanically plausible axis, visibly touch it rather than float, and the open temple must remain physically connected to the frame through the hinge. Show sufficient context around the hinge that the eyeglasses and repair action can be understood. Only this one screwdriver; no tool piles, no electronics, no dangerous objects, no wooden box or broad furniture hinge. No hands are needed. The screwdriver shaft approaches from upper right toward the small hinge in the center-left of the photographic band; the open temple extends toward the right. A shallow but controlled depth of field keeps screw head, blade tip, hinge knuckle and immediately adjacent frame connection clear while distant temple and background soften gradually. Camera sees the side/top of the hinge at an oblique close angle, enough to resolve the slotted screw head and temple pivot without impossible geometry.

Material rules: clear curved lens has subdued transmitted light, a fine edge reflection and very slight localized optical distortion, not milky rough glass. Acetate rim is largely smooth with gently changing highlights around its curved form and subtle wear only at plausible localized points. Stainless hinge and screw have narrow directional reflections shaped by their small metal faces, not a dense decorative grain pattern. Driver shaft has a different, restrained steel reflection; its blade is fine and appropriately scaled to the screw. The cool gray background is smooth matte, without repeated micro-speckles. Soft daylight from upper left produces consistent contact shadows beneath the frame and temple. Detail varies by material, object scale, curvature, light and focus; do not put the same busy microtexture on metal, lens, frame and background, do not fill every blank surface with grit. Maintain sharp physical edges at the focal repair point and softer distant edges without white masking halos. No arbitrary glow, vignette, paper simulation or blanket texture.

Typography and space: use a confident upright Korean sans serif with natural-width glyphs. Dark graphite lettering on a clean cool off-white field; a limited deep red accent for the application line may be used, but no blue application banner, badges, icons, invented subheads or fake marks. The full title is the first clear reading, set large and weighty, with its left alignment carried through subtitle, image repair point and lower information. Keep the Korean title words intact and legible; do not scatter or distort syllables. The original information has separate semantic groups: event date/time/place; audience and object to bring; four operational/safety/consent clauses; fee; application deadline with full URL; contact. Use whitespace and only a few weight contrasts to distinguish these groups. Do not make every line bold. Make the most lengthy mandatory sentence and all small conditions comfortably readable at a 720-pixel-wide full poster view. Allocate actual wide text area and sensible line breaks between words; no forced horizontal compression. Keep all information safely within page margins. The application deadline and entire haram-mend.example/join URL should be especially easy to find and read, in normal-width natural proportions; allow two lines between the Korean part and the URL if useful while preserving every character. The photo is not a backdrop behind mandatory small type. No tiny footer strip containing the conditions. No copy deletion to enlarge the photograph.

PRINT ALL AND ONLY the following 14 text items exactly once. Preserve every spelling, space, number, colon, middle dot, dash and punctuation. The instructions above are not poster text. Do not invent labels or repeat the title. Natural line wrapping within an item is allowed between complete words; do not alter the text itself:
고쳐 쓰는 토요일
이웃 수리 작업실 참여자 모집
2026년 12월 5일 토요일
오후 2시–5시 · 입장은 오후 1시 40분부터
하람시 잇는집 2층 · 수선길 12
대상: 만 16세 이상 · 회차별 12명
작은 생활용품 한 점을 가져와 주세요.
전기·배터리 제품과 위험한 물건은 받지 않습니다.
도구는 제공하며 부품 비용은 현장에서 안내합니다.
수리 여부는 상태 확인 후 결정하며 완성을 보장하지 않습니다.
촬영은 동의한 참여자에 한해 진행합니다.
참가비 5,000원 · 현장 결제
12월 2일까지 신청: haram-mend.example/join
문의: 이웃 수리 운영팀

Output: exactly one complete flat 3:4 poster image, no frame mockup, no folded sheet, no multi-panel alternatives, no logo, no watermark. Full native photographic and typographic finish.
